name: Honey, palm and butter
oneLine: Your two favorites as one: Butter and bone's whiter paper and butter highlights, with Honey and palm's deeper honey button and soft sage green beside it.
fromTheGrid: Pale sand barely warmed for the paper; the mustard of your overlay text, pulled toward honey, as the button and made very pale as the wash; the palm and olive leaf made soft as the second color; lava and forest-black words; deep foliage for the dark band.
trend: Both of the pairings your two favorites lean on: green as the most picked color family for 2027, and butter yellow with warm off-white in Pantone's Spring/Summer 2027 fashion report. Mixing them is our choice.
whatChanged: From Butter and bone: the paper, the cards, the butter second background and the butter wash. From Honey and palm: the honey button, the sage second color and the deep palm for the dark band. Straw butter stays on as a supporting color.

name: Honey and palm
oneLine: The same late-afternoon gold, standing under the palms: bone paper with the yellow turned down, a honey button, and a soft sage green where the sea haze was.
fromTheGrid: Backgrounds from the pale sand (#ddddda, #d1ccc0) lifted lighter with a breath of the olive (#767f63); text from the forest-black of the lava rock (#1b2119) warmed with espresso (#382417); the button is the mustard overlay text (#d8ac4b) pulled a little toward honey, with a darker edge and dark words; the second color is the palm and olive leaf (#767f63) made pale; the dark band is the deep foliage (#2f362b) warmed; good moves to a sea green from the deep ocean (#305c72) so a status never looks like the sage; heads up is driftwood (#866340), late the clay deepened.
trend: Green is the most repeated color family among the 2027 paint picks (Dulux, Behr, Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore all chose a green). Dulux's is a soft sage, Soulful Sage, with a warm 'Glow' companion palette that includes honey and clay tones. Gold with sage is our pairing, not a published one.
whatChanged: The pale sea-haze blue becomes a pale palm sage, the paper loses some yellow, the dark band turns from driftwood to deep foliage, and the gold warms a touch toward honey.

name: Butter and bone
oneLine: The softest one, and the all-yellow one: a whiter bone paper, a paler butter-gold button, a butter wash for highlights, and a straw butter as the second color. No green and no blue.
fromTheGrid: Backgrounds from the pale sand and soft white (#ddddda, #f3f4f5) barely warmed; text from the lava and forest-black (#1b2119) warmed with espresso (#382417); the button is the mustard overlay text (#d8ac4b) almost as it appears on your posts, with a darker gold edge and dark words; the highlight wash is that same mustard made very pale, a butter; the second color is that mustard again, dusted with the wet sand (#d1ccc0) into a straw butter; the dark band is driftwood (#866340) deepened; good is a sea green from the deep ocean (#305c72), heads up driftwood, late the clay deepened.
trend: Pantone's New York Fashion Week Spring/Summer 2027 report has a pale butter yellow (Anise Flower) in its top ten, and a dark golden brown (Arrowwood), a warm off-white (Antique White) and a muted herbal green (Tarragon) among its five core neutrals, as reported by FashionUnited. Putting them together is our choice, and this take leaves the green out.
whatChanged: The button goes paler and sunnier (so it leans harder on its dark edge), the paper goes whiter, highlights get a butter wash, and the sea haze becomes a straw butter, so the whole page stays in one yellow family.
